input.quote: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated, with a direct Internet connection of shared but greater than T-1 bandwidth, plus capacity to process continuously during burst periods. HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale:
Section 1.4 is the grant of access/use rights running to us (the Company). It names only "the Company", so our affiliates and the contractors and agents who will actually build, populate and administer the Site are not covered, and the administration-tool access is confined to the narrow purpose of monitoring catalog information. The grant is also silent on revocability, leaving HDI room to suspend or withdraw access outside the Section 4 termination mechanics. Successor transfer is already addressed by Section 10.3 (agreement inures to successors and assigns), so no edit is needed there, and the negotiated one-year renewable term with a termination payment is left intact rather than converting to a breach-only termination standard. The redline therefore makes the minimal changes: adding affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, broadening tool access to the exercise of our rights, and confirming irrevocability during the term.</parationale>

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to the Company's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and make those rights irrevocable during the term (subject only to Section 4 termination).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our group and third-party developers/agents will need to use the hosting system and administration tools to operate the Site. We also confirmed the rights are irrevocable for the term and cannot be suspended at HDI's discretion outside the Section 4 termination mechanics; if affiliate coverage is a concern, we can accept adding affiliates on written notice to HDI.
